propositions: Detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit text/JSON, close errors, web review UI) must render derived plan-review relationship health from the shared DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without recreating independent status strings.

Each surface displays canonical related ticket ID, normalized role, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed and required review phase, and effective execution floor.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift is labeled advisory, and legacy-unpinned is distinguished from current-no-relationships, while overall validity presentation stays true.
Ordinary list output and stored ticket events remain unchanged; schema changes are additive and preserve rollback compatibility.

Audit health integration occurs at build_context/page assembly after audit_trail produces best-effort data, catching missing attestation, timeouts, or exceptions at that boundary and rendering derived-health-unavailable without changing audit_trail never-raise or close allow/deny semantics.
Advanced plan-review/attestation docs (not basic user docs) cover pin enforcement toggles, phase metadata, rollout, deletion repair, validity profiles, and close-versus-claim freshness.
